title.en: The Apocalypse: Heavenly Visions and New Creation
title.am: የዮሐንስ ራእይ፡ ሰማያዊ ራእያትና አዲሲቱ ፍጥረት

title.en: John hears a voice like a trumpet while in the Spirit on the island of Patmos
title.am: ዮሐንስ በፍጥሞ ደሴት ሳለ እንደ መለከት ያለ ታላቅ ድምፅ ሰማ

events.note: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last; write what you see in a book.

title.en: John beholds the Son of Man standing in glory among seven golden lampstands
title.am: ዮሐንስ የሰውን ልጅ በሰባቱ የወርቅ መቅረዞች መካከል በክብር አየ

events.note: Clothed with a robe down to the feet and girded with a golden chest band.

title.en: The Slain Lamb takes the seven-sealed scroll amidst songs of heavenly elders
title.am: የታረደው በግ ሰባቱ ማኅተሞች ያሉበትን መጽሐፍ ተቀበለ

events.note: You are worthy to take the scroll and to open its seals, for You were slain.

title.en: Archangel Michael and his angels defeat and cast the dragon out of heaven
title.am: ቅዱስ ሚካኤልና መላእክቱ ዘንዶውን ተዋግተው ወደ ምድር ጣሉት

events.note: Now salvation, and strength, and the kingdom of our God have come.

title.en: The Word of God rides forth conquering on a white horse with eyes like flame
title.am: የእግዚአብሔር ቃል በነጭ ፈረስ ላይ በድል አድራጊነት ወጣ

events.note: On His robe and on His thigh He has a name written: King of kings and Lord of lords.

title.en: The holy city, New Jerusalem, descends out of heaven adorned like a bride
title.am: አዲሲቱ ኢየሩሳሌም እንደ ሙሽራ ተዘጋጅታ ከሰማይ ወረደች

events.note: God Himself will be with them; He will wipe away every tear from their eyes.

title.en: The river of the water of life flows clear as crystal from the throne of God
title.am: የሕይወት ውኃ ወንዝ ከእግዚአብሔር ዙፋን እንደ መስታወት እየጠራ ወጣ

events.note: Bearing the tree of life whose twelve leaves are for the healing of the nations.

title.en: Signs in the Public Ministry of Christ
title.am: በክርስቶስ የማዳን አገልግሎት የተፈጸሙ ምልክቶች

title.en: Christ is baptized; the Spirit descends as a dove
title.am: ክርስቶስ ተጠመቀ፤ መንፈስ ቅዱስም በርግብ አምሳል ወረደ

events.note: This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.

title.en: Jesus performs His first sign turning water into wine at Cana
title.am: ኢየሱስ በቃና ዘገሊላ ውኃውን ወደ ወይን ለወጠ

events.note: He manifested His glory, and His disciples believed in Him.

title.en: Jesus feeds five thousand with five loaves and two fish
title.am: ኢየሱስ አምስት ሺህ ሰዎችን በአምስት እንጀራ መገበ

events.note: All ate and were filled; twelve baskets of leftovers remained.

title.en: The Transfiguration of Christ before Peter, James, and John
title.am: የክርስቶስ ክብር በደብረ ታቦር ተገለጠ

events.note: His face shone like the sun and His garments became radiant light.

title.en: Jesus raises Lazarus from the dead after four days in the tomb
title.am: ኢየሱስ አልዓዛርን ከአራት ቀናት መቃብር አስነሣው

events.note: I am the resurrection and the life; whoever believes in me shall never die.

title.en: From Jordan Crossing to Samuel
title.am: ከዮርዳኖስ ማዶ እስከ ሳሙኤል

title.en: Twelve memorial stones set up from the dry riverbed of the Jordan
title.am: ከዮርዳኖስ ወንዝ አሥራ ሁለት የመታሰቢያ ድንጋዮች ተነሡ

events.note: A permanent memorial for generations that the waters of Jordan were cut off.

title.en: Priests blow ram’s horn trumpets and Jericho’s walls collapse
title.am: ካህናቱ ቀንደ መለከት ነፉ፤ የኢያሪኮም ቅጥር ወደቀ

events.note: The people shouted with a great shout and the city wall fell flat.

title.en: Deborah and Barak chant their hymn of victory after defeating Sisera
title.am: ዲቦራና ባራቅ የድል መዝሙራቸውን አቀረቡ

events.note: Praising the Lord for the leaders in Israel who willingly offered themselves.

title.en: Gideon’s 300 break clay pitchers and blow trumpets at midnight
title.am: የጌዴዎን 300 ሰዎች ማሰሮዎችን ሰብረው መለከት ነፉ

events.note: The sword of the Lord and of Gideon caused Midian to flee.

title.en: Young Samuel hears God calling his name in the tabernacle of Shiloh
title.am: ብላቴናው ሳሙኤል በሴሎ የእግዚአብሔርን ጥሪ ሰማ

events.note: Speak, Lord, for your servant hears; Samuel was confirmed as prophet.

title.en: Creation to the Righteous Enoch
title.am: ከፍጥረት እስከ ጻድቁ ሄኖክ

title.en: God speaks light into existence
title.am: እግዚአብሔር ብርሃንን በቃሉ ፈጠረ

events.note: God said: Let there be light; and there was light on the first day.

title.en: God plants the Garden of Eden
title.am: እግዚአብሔር የዔዴንን ገነት ተከለ

events.note: The Lord God placed Adam in the garden to tend and keep it.

title.en: Abel offers a pleasing firstling sacrifice
title.am: አቤል የተወደደውን የበኵር መሥዋዕት አቀረበ

events.note: The Lord respected Abel and his offering, while Cain grew jealous.

title.en: Seth is born to replace righteous Abel
title.am: ሴት በጻድቁ አቤል ምትክ ተወለደ

events.note: Eve named him Seth, saying: God has appointed another seed for me.

title.en: Enoch walks with God and is taken without death
title.am: ሄኖክ አካሄዱን ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር አደረገ፤ አልተገኘምም

events.note: Enoch walked with God three hundred years and was translated without seeing death.

title.en: The Six Days of Creation and the Sabbath
title.am: የሥነ ፍጥረት ስድስቱ ቀናትና ሰንበት

title.en: Day 1: God speaks light into existence
title.am: ቀን 1፡ እግዚአብሔር ብርሃንን በቃሉ ፈጠረ

events.note: God said: Let there be light, separating light from darkness.

title.en: Day 2: God establishes the firmament of heaven
title.am: ቀን 2፡ እግዚአብሔር ጠፈርን በውኃዎች መካከል አደረገ

events.note: Dividing waters under the firmament from waters above.

title.en: Day 3: Dry land appears and yields plants and fruit trees
title.am: ቀን 3፡ የብስ ተገለጠ፤ ሣርና ፍሬ የሚያፈራ ዛፍ በቀለ

events.note: Gathering the seas together and adorning the earth with vegetation.

title.en: Day 4: God places the sun, moon, and stars in the heavens
title.am: ቀን 4፡ እግዚአብሔር ፀሐይን፣ ጨረቃንና ከዋክብትን አኖረ

events.note: To give light upon the earth and mark signs, seasons, days, and years.

title.en: Day 5: Waters swarm with sea creatures and birds fly across the sky
title.am: ቀን 5፡ ባሕር በሕያዋን ፍጥረታት ተሞላ፤ አዕዋፍም በሰማይ በረሩ

events.note: God blessed them, saying: Be fruitful and multiply.

title.en: Day 6: God forms land beasts and creates man in His image
title.am: ቀን 6፡ እግዚአብሔር አራዊትን ፈጠረ፤ ሰውንም በመልኩ አበጀ

events.note: Creating man male and female to exercise righteous stewardship.

title.en: Day 7: God rests from all His works and sanctifies the Sabbath
title.am: ቀን 7፡ እግዚአብሔር ከሥራው ሁሉ ዐረፈ፤ ሰንበትንም ቀደሰ

events.note: God blessed the seventh day and sanctified it as holy rest.

title.en: Daniel: Faith and Prophecy in Babylon
title.am: ነቢዩ ዳንኤል፡ እምነትና ራእይ በባቢሎን

title.en: Daniel and the three youths choose vegetables and water over the king’s meat
title.am: ዳንኤልና ሦስቱ ሕፃናት ከንጉሡ ማዕድ ይልቅ ጥራጥሬ መረጡ

events.note: At the end of ten days their countenance appeared fairer and fatter than all others.

title.en: Daniel reveals Nebuchadnezzar’s dream of the great four-metal statue
title.am: ዳንኤል የአራቱን መንግሥታት ታላቅ ምስል ሕልም ፈታ

events.note: A supernatural stone cut without hands shattered the image and filled the whole earth.

title.en: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego walk unharmed in the seven-times heated furnace
title.am: ሲድራቅ፣ ሚሳቅና አብደናጎ በእቶን እሳት ሳይቃጠሉ ተመላለሱ

events.note: The form of the fourth person in the fire was like the Son of God.

title.en: Daniel interprets the mysterious handwriting on the wall at Belshazzar’s feast
title.am: ዳንኤል በግድግዳው ላይ የተጻፈውን ምስጢር ፈታ

events.note: Mene, Mene, Tekel, Upharsin: Babylon fell that very night to Darius the Mede.

title.en: God shuts the lions’ mouths so Daniel emerges unhurt from the den
title.am: እግዚአብሔር የአንበሶቹን አፍ ዘግቶ ዳንኤል በሰላም ወጣ

events.note: No injury was found on him because he trusted wholeheartedly in his God.

title.en: The Apostolic Church in Jerusalem
title.am: የቀደመችው ሐዋርያዊት ቤተ ክርስቲያን በኢየሩሳሌም

title.en: Matthias is chosen by prayer and lot in the upper room to fill the apostolic twelve
title.am: ማትያስ በጸሎትና በዕጣ በአሥራ ሁለቱ ሐዋርያት ማዕረግ ተቆጠረ

events.note: Numbered with the eleven apostles to be a witness of Christ’s resurrection.

title.en: The Holy Spirit descends like rushing wind and tongues of fire on Pentecost
title.am: በበዓለ ሃምሳ መንፈስ ቅዱስ እንደ ኃይለኛ ነፋስና የእሳት ላንቃ ወረደ

events.note: Filled with the Spirit, Peter preached and about three thousand souls were baptized.

title.en: Peter and John heal the lifelong lame man at the Temple’s Beautiful Gate
title.am: ጴጥሮስና ዮሐንስ በውብ ደጅ ሽባውን ሰው በኢየሱስ ስም ፈወሱት

events.note: Silver and gold have I none; but what I have I give you: In the name of Jesus, rise up and walk!

title.en: The Apostles lay hands on seven men of good report to serve the church tables
title.am: ሐዋርያት በማዕድ እንዲያገለግሉ ሰባቱን ዲያቆናት ሾሙ

events.note: Stephen, Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolas.

title.en: Stephen sees heaven opened and becomes the first Christian protomartyr
title.am: እስጢፋኖስ ሰማያት ተከፍተው አየ፤ የመጀመሪያው ሰማዕት ሆኖ ዐረፈ

events.note: Kneeling as stones struck him, praying: Lord, do not charge them with this sin.

title.en: Apostolic Witness in the Book of Acts
title.am: የሐዋርያት ምስክርነት በግብረ ሐዋርያት

title.en: Descent of the Holy Spirit in tongues of fire on Pentecost
title.am: በበዓለ ሃምሳ መንፈስ ቅዱስ በእሳት አምሳል ወረደ

events.note: Divided tongues like fire rested upon each of them, filling them with the Spirit.

title.en: Peter heals the lame man at the Beautiful Gate of the Temple
title.am: ጴጥሮስ በቤተ መቅደስ ደጅ ሽባውን ሰው ፈወሰው

events.note: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, rise up and walk!

title.en: Stephen is stoned outside Jerusalem as the first martyr
title.am: እስጢፋኖስ የመጀመሪያው ሰማዕት ሆኖ ተወገረ

events.note: Lord Jesus, receive my spirit; Lord, do not hold this sin against them.

title.en: Philip preaches to and baptizes the Ethiopian royal official
title.am: ፊልጶስ ኢትዮጵያዊውን ጃንደረባ አጠመቀው

events.note: Both Philip and the eunuch went down into the water, and he baptized him.

title.en: Saul blinded by heavenly light and converted on Damascus Road
title.am: ሳውል በደማስቆ መንገድ በሰማያዊ ብርሃን ተመለሰ

events.note: Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me? He arose, was baptized, and proclaimed Christ.

title.en: The Inauguration of Christ’s Public Ministry
title.am: የጌታችን የይፋዊ አገልግሎት መጀመሪያ

title.en: Christ is baptized in the Jordan and the Holy Spirit descends like a dove
title.am: ክርስቶስ በዮርዳኖስ ተጠመቀ፤ መንፈስ ቅዱስም በርግብ አምሳል ወረደ

events.note: The voice of the Father sounded: This is My beloved Son in whom I am well pleased.

title.en: Christ fasts forty days and nights, repelling Satan’s triple temptations
title.am: ክርስቶስ አርባ ቀንና ሌሊት ጾመ፤ ፈታኙን ዲያብሎስንም ድል ነሣ

events.note: Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds from God’s mouth.

title.en: Christ performs His first sign turning water into wine at the wedding in Cana
title.am: ክርስቶስ በቃና ዘገሊላ ውኃውን ወደ ወይን በመለወጥ የመጀመሪያውን ተአምር አደረገ

events.note: Manifesting His divine glory, and His disciples believed in Him.

title.en: Christ cleanses the Temple court with a whip of cords in Jerusalem
title.am: ክርስቶስ የገመድ ጅራፍ አበጅቶ መቅደሱን ከነጋዴዎች አነጻ

events.note: Take these things away! Do not make My Father’s house a house of merchandise.

title.en: Christ calls Peter, Andrew, James, and John by the Sea of Galilee
title.am: ክርስቶስ አራቱን ዓሣ አጥማጆች በገሊላ ባሕር ዳር ጠራቸው

events.note: Follow Me, and I will make you fishers of men; they left their nets immediately.

title.en: Christ delivers the Sermon on the Mount and proclaims the Beatitudes
title.am: ክርስቶስ በተራራው ላይ ስብከቱን አስተማረ፤ ብፅዕናዎችንም አወጀ

events.note: Teaching them as one having authority, and not as the scribes.

title.en: The Ministries of Elijah and Elisha
title.am: የነቢያት ኤልያስና ኤልሳዕ ተጋድሎ

title.en: Fire consumes the sacrifice on Mount Carmel before all Israel
title.am: በደብረ ቀርሜሎስ መሥዋዕቱ በእሳት ተቃጠለ

events.note: The people fell on their faces crying: The Lord, He is God!

title.en: God speaks to Elijah in a still small voice at Mount Horeb
title.am: እግዚአብሔር ለኤልያስ በቀጭን ዝግታ ድምፅ ተናገረው

events.note: Not in the earthquake or fire, but in a gentle whispering breeze.

title.en: Elijah taken up in the whirlwind; his mantle falls upon Elisha
title.am: ኤልያስ በዐውሎ ነፋስ ዐረገ፤ መጎናጸፊያውም ለኤልሳዕ ወደቀች

events.note: Elisha struck the waters of the Jordan with the mantle and they parted.

title.en: Elisha raises the Shunammite woman’s dead son to life
title.am: ኤልሳዕ የሱናማዊቷን ልጅ ከሞት አስነሣው

events.note: The boy sneezed seven times, opened his eyes, and was restored to his mother.

title.en: God strikes the surrounding Syrian army with blindness at Dothan
title.am: እግዚአብሔር የሶርያን ሠራዊት በዕውርነት መታ

events.note: Those who are with us are more than those who are with them.

title.en: The Gospel Reaches the Gentiles
title.am: የወንጌል ብርሃን ለአሕዛብ መድረስ

title.en: Philip preaches Christ in Samaria with great joy and miracles
title.am: ፊልጶስ በሰማርያ ወንጌልን ሰበከ፤ ታላቅ ደስታም ሆነ

events.note: Crowds with one accord heeded the things spoken by Philip.

title.en: Philip explains the prophet Isaiah and baptizes the Queen’s Ethiopian treasurer
title.am: ፊልጶስ ለኢትዮጵያዊው ጃንደረባ ኢሳይያስን አስረድቶ አጠመቀው

events.note: The eunuch went on his way rejoicing, bringing Christianity home to Ethiopia.

title.en: A brilliant light blinds Saul on the road to Damascus as Christ calls him
title.am: በደማስቆ መንገድ ድንቅ ብርሃን ሳውልን አበራበት፤ ክርስቶስም ጠራው

events.note: Saul, Saul, why do you persecute Me? I am Jesus whom you are persecuting.

title.en: Peter sees the great sheet at Joppa and baptizes Cornelius’s household in Caesarea
title.am: ጴጥሮስ በኢዮጴ ራእይ አየ፤ በቂሣርያም የቆርኔሌዎስን ቤተሰብ አጠመቀ

events.note: The Holy Spirit fell on all who heard the word, proving God shows no partiality.

title.en: The Jerusalem Council decrees that Gentile converts need not observe circumcision
title.am: የኢየሩሳሌም ጉባኤ ለአሕዛብ አማኞች የግርዛት ቀንበር እንዳይጫን ወሰነ

events.note: It seemed good to the Holy Spirit and to us to lay upon you no greater burden.

title.en: The Mystery of the Incarnation and Infancy of Christ
title.am: የሥጋዌ ምስጢርና የጌታችን የልጅነት ታሪክ

title.en: Archangel Gabriel announces the Conception of the Word to the Virgin Mary
title.am: መልአኩ ቅዱስ ገብርኤል ለእመቤታችን የልደቱን ምስጢር አበሰረ

events.note: Rejoice, highly favored one, the Lord is with you; blessed are you among women.

title.en: Mary visits Elizabeth; the unborn infant John leaps for joy in her womb
title.am: እመቤታችን ኤልሳቤጥን ጎበኘች፤ ዮሐንስም በማኅፀን ሰገደ

events.note: Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit: Blessed is the fruit of your womb!

title.en: Christ is born in Bethlehem and wrapped in swaddling cloths in a manger
title.am: ጌታችን በቤተልሔም በረት ተወለደ፤ በጨርቅም ተጠቀለለ

events.note: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, goodwill toward men.

title.en: Shepherds hurry to Bethlehem and find Mary, Joseph, and the Child in the manger
title.am: እረኞች በፍጥነት መጥተው ሕፃኑን በበረት አገኙት

events.note: Returning glorifying and praising God for all the things they had heard and seen.

title.en: Righteous Simeon takes the Infant Jesus in his arms in the Jerusalem Temple
title.am: ጻድቁ ስምዖን ሕፃኑን ኢየሱስን በቤተ መቅደስ ታቀፈው

events.note: Lord, now let Your servant depart in peace, for my eyes have seen Your salvation.

title.en: Magi from the East worship the Child and offer gold, frankincense, and myrrh
title.am: ሰብአ ሰገል ለሕፃኑ ሰግደው ወርቅ፣ ዕጣንና ከርቤ አቀረቡ

events.note: Warned in a dream not to return to Herod, they departed to their country another way.

title.en: Joseph flees by night with Mary and the Child into Egypt to escape Herod
title.am: ዮሴፍ ሕፃኑንና እናቱን ይዞ በሌሊት ወደ ግብፅ ሸሸ

events.note: Remaining in Egypt until the death of Herod to fulfill prophetic Scripture.

title.en: The Holy Passion and Sufferings of Christ
title.am: የጌታችን ቅዱስ ሕማማትና ስቅለት

title.en: Christ enters Jerusalem on an ass while crowds wave palm branches shouting Hosanna
title.am: ክርስቶስ በሆሣዕና በአህያ ተቀምጦ በክብር ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ገባ

events.note: Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!

title.en: Christ washes the disciples’ feet and institutes the Holy Eucharist
title.am: ክርስቶስ የደቀ መዛሙርቱን እግር አጠበ፤ ቅዱስ ቁርባንንም መሠረተ

events.note: Take, eat; this is My body. Drink of it, all of you; for this is My blood of the covenant.

title.en: Christ prays in agony in the Garden of Gethsemane with sweat like blood
title.am: ክርስቶስ በጌቴሴማኒ የአትክልት ስፍራ በታላቅ ጭንቀት ጸለየ

events.note: Father, if it is Your will, take this cup from Me; nevertheless not My will, but Yours be done.

title.en: Judas betrays the Lord with a kiss and soldiers arrest Him in the garden
title.am: ይሁዳ ጌታን በመሳም አሳልፎ ሰጠው፤ ወታደሮችም ያዙት

events.note: Friend, why have you come? Then they laid hands on Jesus and took Him.

title.en: Pontius Pilate washes his hands and sentences Christ to be crucified
title.am: ጳንጥዮስ ጲላጦስ እጁን ታጠበ፤ ክርስቶስም እንዲሰቀል ፈረደበት

events.note: I am innocent of the blood of this just Person; see to it yourselves.

title.en: Christ is crucified at Golgotha between two thieves as darkness falls
title.am: ክርስቶስ በቀራንዮ በሁለት ወንበዴዎች መካከል ተሰቀለ

events.note: Father, forgive them, for they know not what they do. At the ninth hour He yielded His spirit.

title.en: Joseph of Arimathea and Nicodemus wrap Christ’s body and lay Him in the rock tomb
title.am: ዮሴፍና ኒቆዲሞስ የጌታን ቅዱስ ሥጋ በበፍታ ከፍነው በአዲሱ መቃብር አኖሩት

events.note: Rolling a great stone to the door of the tomb as the Sabbath drew near.

title.en: Holy Passion Week to the Resurrection
title.am: ከሕማማት እስከ በዓለ ትንሣኤ

title.en: Triumphant entry into Jerusalem on Palm Sunday
title.am: ሆሣዕና በኢየሩሳሌም በክብር መግባት

events.note: Hosanna to the Son of David! Blessed is He who comes in the Lord’s name!

title.en: Christ institutes the Holy Eucharist at the Mystical Supper
title.am: ክርስቶስ በምሥጢራዊው እራት ቅዱስ ቍርባንን መሠረተ

events.note: Take, eat; this is my body. Drink from it, all of you; this is my blood.

title.en: Agony in the Garden of Gethsemane
title.am: በጌቴሴማኒ የአትክልት ስፍራ የጸሎት ተጋድሎ

events.note: Not my will, but yours be done; His sweat was like great drops of blood.

title.en: Crucifixion and death of Christ on Golgotha on Good Friday
title.am: ስቅለተ ክርስቶስና ሞቱ በቀራንዮ

events.note: He bowed His head and gave up His spirit: It is finished!

title.en: The glorious Resurrection of Christ on the third day
title.am: የክርስቶስ ታላቅ ትንሣኤ በሦስተኛው ቀን

events.note: He is not here; for He is risen, as He said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.

title.en: Joseph: From the Pit to Egypt’s Throne
title.am: ዮሴፍ፡ ከጉድጓድ እስከ ግብፅ ዙፋን

title.en: Joseph dreams of the sheaves and bowing stars
title.am: ዮሴፍ የነዶዎችንና የከዋክብትን ሕልም አየ

events.note: His brothers hated him even more for his prophetic dreams.

title.en: Brothers cast Joseph into a pit at Dothan and sell him
title.am: ወንድሞቹ ዮሴፍን በዶታይን ጉድጓድ ጣሉት

events.note: Sold to Ishmaelite merchants for twenty pieces of silver.

title.en: The Lord prospers Joseph in Potiphar’s household
title.am: እግዚአብሔር በጶጢፋር ቤት ከዮሴፍ ጋር ነበረ

events.note: Potiphar made him overseer over his house and all that he owned.

title.en: Joseph interprets Pharaoh’s dreams of seven fat and lean cows
title.am: ዮሴፍ የፈርዖንን የሰባቱ ላሞች ሕልም ፈታ

events.note: Foreseeing seven years of abundance followed by seven years of famine.

title.en: Joseph reveals his identity and forgives his brothers
title.am: ዮሴፍ ማንነቱን ለወንድሞቹ ገለጠ፤ ይቅርም አላቸው

events.note: You intended to harm me, but God intended it for good to save many people.

title.en: The Period of the Judges
title.am: የመሳፍንት ዘመን

title.en: Israel crosses the Jordan River into the promised land
title.am: እስራኤል የዮርዳኖስን ወንዝ ተሻገሩ

events.note: The priests carrying the ark stepped into the Jordan, and the waters were cut off so the nation could cross on dry ground.

title.en: The walls of Jericho collapse after seven days
title.am: የኢያሪኮ ቅጥር ወደቀ

events.note: When the priests blew the trumpets and the people shouted, the walls of Jericho fell flat.

title.en: Deborah and Barak defeat Sisera at Mount Tabor
title.am: ዲቦራና ባራቅ ሲሳራን አሸነፉ

events.note: Deborah told Barak to advance against Sisera, and the Lord routed Sisera and his chariots.

title.en: Gideon defeats the Midianites with three hundred men
title.am: ጌዴዎን በሦስት መቶ ሰዎች ምድያማውያንን አሸነፈ

events.note: Gideon’s small force blew trumpets and smashed jars holding torches, causing confusion in the Midianite camp.

title.en: Jephthah delivers Israel from the Ammonites
title.am: ዮፍታሔ እስራኤልን ከአሞናውያን ታደገ

events.note: The Spirit of the Lord came upon Jephthah, and he subdued the Ammonites before Israel.

title.en: Samson carries away the city gates of Gaza
title.am: ሶምሶን የጋዛን ከተማ በር ተሸከመ

events.note: Samson arose at midnight, pulled up the city gateposts and bars, and carried them to the top of the hill facing Hebron.

title.en: Samson pulls down the pillars of the Philistine temple
title.am: ሶምሶን የፍልስጥኤማውያንን ምሰሶዎች አፈረሰ

events.note: Samson prayed for strength one last time, broke the central pillars, and brought down the house upon the Philistine rulers.

title.en: Ruth gleans in the fields of Boaz in Bethlehem
title.am: ሩት በቦዔዝ እርሻ ቃረመች

events.note: During the days of the judges, Ruth found favor in the eyes of Boaz, leading to their marriage and King David’s lineage.

title.en: The Journey of Abraham
title.am: የአባታችን አብርሃም ጉዞ

title.en: God calls Abram to leave Haran for Canaan
title.am: እግዚአብሔር አብራምን ከካራን ጠራው

events.note: Get out of your country to a land that I will show you.

title.en: Melchizedek king of Salem blesses Abram with bread and wine
title.am: የሳሌም ንጉሥ መልከ ጼዴቅ አብራምን ባረከው

events.note: The priest of God Most High brought bread and wine, receiving tithes from Abram.

title.en: God counts Abram righteous and promises seed like the stars
title.am: እግዚአብሔር ዘሩን እንደ ከዋክብት እንደሚያበዛ ቃል ገባለት

events.note: He believed in the Lord, and He accounted it to him for righteousness.

title.en: Abraham welcomes three heavenly visitors by the oaks of Mamre
title.am: አብርሃም ሦስቱን እንግዶች በመምሬ ዛፍ ሥር አስተናገደ

events.note: Abraham bowed to the ground and prepared fresh cakes and calf for them.

title.en: Abraham binds Isaac upon the altar on Mount Moriah
title.am: አብርሃም ይስሐቅን በሞሪያ ተራራ ላይ አሰረው

events.note: God provided a ram caught by its horns in a thicket in place of his son.

title.en: Apostle Paul: Herald to the Nations
title.am: ሐዋርያው ጳውሎስ፡ ለአሕዛብ የተላከ አርበኛ

title.en: Prophets and teachers in Antioch fast and send out Paul and Barnabas
title.am: በአንጾኪያ የነበሩ መምህራን ጳውሎስንና በርናባስን ጸልየው ላኩ

events.note: The Holy Spirit said: Separate to Me Barnabas and Saul for the work I have called them.

title.en: An earthquake shakes the Philippi prison as Paul and Silas sing hymns at midnight
title.am: ጳውሎስና ሲላስ በሌሊት ሲዘምሩ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ወህኒ ቤቱን አናወጠ

events.note: All the doors were opened and everyone’s chains were loosed; the jailer was baptized.

title.en: Paul proclaims the True Creator at the Areopagus in Athens to the Unknown God
title.am: ጳውሎስ በአቴና በአርዮስፋጎስ ለማይታወቀው አምላክ የተሰየመውን መሠዊያ ገለጠ

events.note: The One whom you worship without knowing, Him I proclaim to you.

title.en: The silversmith Demetrius stirs a great riot against Paul in the theater at Ephesus
title.am: ድሜጥሮስ በኤፌሶን በጳውሎስ ላይ ታላቅ ሁከት አስነሣ

events.note: For two hours the crowd shouted: Great is Artemis of the Ephesians!

title.en: Paul’s ship fractures in the storm, but all 276 passengers escape safely to Malta
title.am: መርከቡ ተሰብሮ 276ቱ መንገደኞች በሙሉ በሰላም ማልታ ደረሱ

events.note: An angel assured Paul that no life would be lost; they washed ashore on planks.

title.en: Paul spends two whole years in his rented house in Rome preaching unhindered
title.am: ጳውሎስ በሮም በተከራየው ቤት ለሁለት ዓመታት ወንጌልን ያለከልካይ ሰበከ

events.note: Preaching the kingdom of God and teaching concerning the Lord Jesus Christ with all confidence.

title.en: The Great Flood and the Covenant of the Rainbow
title.am: የኖኅ የጥፋት ውኃና የቀስተ ደመና ኪዳን

title.en: God commands righteous Noah to construct the ark of gopher wood
title.am: እግዚአብሔር ኖኅን ከግንድ መርከብ እንዲሠራ አዘዘው

events.note: Building three interior decks according to precise divine dimensions.

title.en: Living creatures enter the ark two by two and God shuts the door
title.am: እንስሳት ሁለት ሁለት ሆነው ገቡ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ደጁን ዘጋ

events.note: Pairs of every flesh entered before the rains descended.

title.en: Fountains of the deep burst and rain falls forty days and nights
title.am: የጥልቁ ምንጮች ተገነፈሉ፤ ዝናብም አርባ ቀንና ሌሊት ዘነበ

events.note: Waters prevailed fifteen cubits above the highest mountain peaks.

title.en: The ark comes to rest upon the mountains of Ararat
title.am: መርከቧ በአራራት ተራሮች ላይ በሰላም አረፈች

events.note: Grounding securely as the waters steadily abated.

title.en: The dove returns at evening bearing a freshly plucked olive leaf
title.am: ርግቧ የወይራ ቅጠል በአፏ ይዛ በመሸ ጊዜ ተመለሰች

events.note: Giving joyful proof that the trees of the earth were emerging.

title.en: God establishes the rainbow covenant never again to flood the earth
title.am: እግዚአብሔር ምድርን ዳግም ላያጠፋ የቀስተ ደመና ኪዳን አቆመ

events.note: I set my bow in the cloud as an everlasting covenant token.

title.en: The Patriarch Jacob: From Bethel to Peniel
title.am: የአባታችን የያዕቆብ ጉዞ፡ ከቤቴል እስከ ጵንኤል

title.en: Jacob purchases the firstborn birthright from Esau for lentil stew
title.am: ያዕቆብ የብኩርናን መብት በምስር ወጥ ከዔሳው ገዛ

events.note: Esau despised his spiritual birthright when returning faint from hunting.

title.en: Isaac bestows the patriarch’s blessing upon Jacob
title.am: ይስሐቅ አባታዊውን የበረከት ቃል ለያዕቆብ ሰጠው

events.note: May God give you of the dew of heaven and fatness of the earth.

title.en: Jacob dreams of the heavenly ladder with ascending angels at Bethel
title.am: ያዕቆብ በቤቴል የመላእክትን መወጣጫ መሰላል በሕልም አየ

events.note: Anointing the pillow stone with oil, naming the place House of God.

title.en: Jacob serves Laban twenty years in Haran and marries Leah and Rachel
title.am: ያዕቆብ በካራን ለሀያ ዓመታት ላባን አገለገለ

events.note: Bearing twelve sons who became the founding patriarchs of Israel.

title.en: Jacob wrestles with the angel until dawn at Peniel and is named Israel
title.am: ያዕቆብ በጵንኤል ከመልአክ ጋር ታግሎ እስራኤል ተባለ

events.note: You have struggled with God and with men, and have prevailed.

title.en: Jacob bows seven times and reconciles peacefully with his brother Esau
title.am: ያዕቆብ ሰባት ጊዜ ሰግዶ ከወንድሙ ከዔሳው ጋር ታረቀ

events.note: Esau ran to meet him, fell on his neck, and wept with brotherly love.

title.en: The Journeys of Saint Paul
title.am: የቅዱስ ጳውሎስ ሐዋርያዊ ጉዞዎች

title.en: The church at Antioch lays hands on Paul and Barnabas and sends them
title.am: የአንጾኪያ ቤተ ክርስቲያን ጳውሎስንና በርናባስን ላከች

events.note: Guided by the Holy Spirit, the prophets and teachers at Antioch fasted, prayed, laid hands on them, and sent them forth.

title.en: Paul and Silas sing hymns at midnight in the Philippian prison
title.am: ጳውሎስና ሲላስ በእስር ቤት ሳሉ እግዚአብሔርን አመሰገኑ

events.note: While they sang in bonds, a violent earthquake shook the prison foundations, opening all the doors.

title.en: Paul proclaims the Unknown God to the philosophers at Athens
title.am: ጳውሎስ በአቴና ያልታወቀውን አምላክ ሰበከ

events.note: Paul stood in the midst of the Areopagus and revealed that the Creator who made the world needs nothing from human hands.

title.en: Paul teaches daily in Ephesus and the word of the Lord spreads
title.am: ጳውሎስ በኤፌሶን የጌታን ቃል በስፋት አስተማረ

events.note: For two years Paul reasoned in the hall of Tyrannus, so that all residents of Asia heard the word.

title.en: Paul is seized at the Temple in Jerusalem and rescued by tribunes
title.am: ጳውሎስ በኢየሩሳሌም ቤተ መቅደስ ተያዘ

events.note: A riot broke out at the Temple, and Roman soldiers rescued Paul from the crowd before escorting him to the barracks.

title.en: Paul survives the shipwreck and lands safely on Malta
title.am: ጳውሎስ በመርከብ መሰበር ወቅት በማልታ ደሴት ተረፈ

events.note: All 276 people on board escaped safely to the shore on planks and pieces of the ship, just as the angel had assured Paul.

title.en: Paul preaches the kingdom of God under house arrest in Rome
title.am: ጳውሎስ በሮም የእግዚአብሔርን መንግሥት ያለ ከልካይ ሰበከ

events.note: For two full years Paul lived in his rented quarters, welcoming all who came to him and preaching with total boldness.

title.en: The Signs and Plagues of Egypt
title.am: በግብፅ የተፈጸሙት ተአምራትና መቅሠፍቶች

title.en: Aaron strikes the Nile and all waters turn to blood
title.am: አሮን ወንዙን መታ፤ የግብፅም ውኃ ሁሉ ደም ሆነ

events.note: Fish died and the Egyptians could not drink from the river for seven days.

title.en: Frogs swarm out of rivers and cover houses throughout Egypt
title.am: ጓጉንቸሮች ከወንዝ ወጥተው የግብፅን ምድር ሸፈኑ

events.note: Entering royal bedchambers, ovens, and kneading troughs.

title.en: Severe hail mixed with blazing fire strikes fields and trees
title.am: ከእሳት ጋር የተቀላቀለ ኃይለኛ በረዶ ምድሪቱን መታ

events.note: Shattering every tree and crop in all Egypt except in Goshen.

title.en: Thick darkness covers Egypt for three days while Israel has light
title.am: ለሦስት ቀናት በግብፅ ላይ ድቅድቅ ጨለማ ሆነ

events.note: No Egyptian rose from his place, but children of Israel had light.

title.en: The tenth plague strikes the firstborn while Passover protects Israel
title.am: አሥረኛው መቅሠፍት የበኩር ልጆችን መታ፤ ፋሲካም እስራኤልን አዳነ

events.note: The destroying angel passed over houses marked with lamb’s blood.

title.en: Pharaoh commands Israel to depart Egypt without delay
title.am: ፈርዖን እስራኤላውያንን በፍጥነት እንዲወጡ አዘዘ

events.note: Israel marched out by their hosts after 430 years of dwelling in Egypt.

title.en: Elijah the Tishbite: The Prophet of Fire
title.am: ነቢዩ ኤልያስ፡ የእሳቱ ነቢይ

title.en: Elijah confronts King Ahab and proclaims years of drought
title.am: ኤልያስ በአክዓብ ፊት ቀርቦ የድርቅን ዘመን አወጀ

events.note: As the Lord lives, there shall not be dew nor rain these years except at my word.

title.en: Elijah stretches himself over the widow’s son and God restores his life
title.am: ኤልያስ በመበለቲቱ ልጅ ላይ ተዘርግቶ ከሞት አስነሣው

events.note: The soul of the child came into him again, and he revived.

title.en: Fire consumes the water-soaked bullock on Mount Carmel
title.am: በደብረ ቀርሜሎስ መሥዋዕቱ በእሳት ተበላ

events.note: The people fell on their faces shouting: The Lord, He is God!

title.en: Elijah bows on Carmel until a cloud the size of a man’s hand rises
title.am: ኤልያስ በጸሎት ተደፍቶ የሰው እጅ የምታህል ደመና ታየች

events.note: The sky grew black with storm clouds, and there was a torrential rain.

title.en: Elijah rebukes Ahab in Naboth’s vineyard for judicial murder
title.am: ኤልያስ አክዓብን በናቡቴ የወይን ቦታ ገሠጸው

events.note: Have you found me, O my enemy? You have sold yourself to do evil.

title.en: Elijah ascends to heaven in a fiery chariot and whirlwind
title.am: ኤልያስ በእሳት ሰረገላና በዐውሎ ነፋስ ወደ ሰማይ ዐረገ

events.note: Dropping his mantle to Elisha as he crossed beyond the Jordan.

title.en: Elisha: Double Portion of the Spirit
title.am: ነቢዩ ኤልሳዕ፡ እጥፍ የመንፈስ ጸጋ

title.en: Elisha takes up Elijah’s fallen mantle and strikes the Jordan
title.am: ኤልሳዕ የኤልያስን መጎናጸፊያ አንሥቶ ዮርዳኖስን መታ

events.note: Where is the Lord God of Elijah? The waters parted immediately.

title.en: Elisha multiplies the poor widow’s single jar of oil to fill all borrowed pots
title.am: ኤልሳዕ የመበለቲቱን ዘይት አበርክቶ ዕቃዎችን ሞላ

events.note: Selling the surplus oil to pay off creditors and save her sons from slavery.

title.en: Elisha prays in the upper chamber and the Shunammite’s son sneezes seven times
title.am: ኤልሳዕ ጸለየ፤ የሱነማዊቷም ልጅ ሰባት ጊዜ አስነጥሶ ተነሣ

events.note: The dead boy opened his eyes, and the mother fell at Elisha’s feet in tears.

title.en: Naaman dips seven times in the Jordan and his leprous flesh is restored
title.am: ንዕማን በዮርዳኖስ ሰባት ጊዜ ተጠምቆ ከለምጹ ነጻ

events.note: His flesh became like the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.

title.en: Elisha prays and his servant sees the mountain full of horses and chariots of fire
title.am: የኤልሳዕ አገልጋይ ተራራው በእሳት ሰረገሎች መሞላቱን አየ

events.note: Do not fear, for those who are with us are more than those who are with them.

title.en: Samuel: The Faithful Prophet and Kingmaker
title.am: ነቢዩ ሳሙኤል፡ ታማኙ ነቢይና ንጉሥ ቀቢ

title.en: Hannah prays silently in the Shiloh tabernacle and dedicates Samuel
title.am: ሐና በሴሎ ድንኳን በጸሎት ተማጽና ሳሙኤልን ሰጠች

events.note: If you give your maidservant a male child, I will give him to the Lord.

title.en: The Lord calls young Samuel three times during the night vigil
title.am: እግዚአብሔር በሌሊት ሳሙኤልን ሦስት ጊዜ ጠራው

events.note: Eli perceived the Lord called the boy, who answered: Speak, your servant hears.

title.en: The Ark is captured by the Philistines and Eli falls from his seat
title.am: ታቦቱ በፍልስጥኤማውያን ተማረከ፤ ዔሊም ከወንበሩ ወደቀ

events.note: Hearing the Ark was taken, Eli fell backward, broke his neck, and died.

title.en: Samuel sets up the stone Ebenezer: Thus far the Lord has helped us
title.am: ሳሙኤል አቤንኤዘር ብሎ የመታሰቢያ ድንጋይ አቆመ

events.note: Commemorating the decisive victory over the Philistine invaders at Mizpah.

title.en: Samuel pours the horn of oil on David among his brothers in Bethlehem
title.am: ሳሙኤል የቀንድ ዘይት በዳዊት ራስ ላይ አፈሰሰ

events.note: Man looks at the outward appearance, but the Lord looks at the heart.

title.en: Elijah to the Babylonian Exile
title.am: ከኤልያስ እስከ ባቢሎን ምርኮ

title.en: Elijah is fed by ravens at the brook Cherith
title.am: ኤልያስ በኮራት ፈፋ በቁራዎች ተመገበ

events.note: During the drought announced to Ahab, God commanded ravens to bring Elijah bread and meat morning and evening.

title.en: Elijah ascends to heaven in a whirlwind and chariot of fire
title.am: ኤልያስ በእሳት ሰረገላ ወደ ሰማይ ዐረገ

events.note: As Elijah and Elisha walked and talked, a chariot of fire separated them, and Elijah went up into heaven.

title.en: Elisha commands Naaman the Syrian to wash and be healed
title.am: ኤልሳዕ ንዕማንን ፈወሰው

events.note: Naaman dipped seven times in the Jordan River and his flesh was restored clean like a young boy’s.

title.en: Jonah preaches repentance to Nineveh after the fish
title.am: ዮናስ በነነዌ ንስሐን ሰበከ

events.note: After being delivered from the great fish, Jonah proclaimed God’s warning to Nineveh, and the city repented.

title.en: Isaiah sees the Lord high and lifted up in the Temple
title.am: ኢሳይያስ የጌታን ክብር በቤተ መቅደስ አየ

events.note: In the year King Uzziah died, Isaiah saw the Lord seated on a throne, with seraphim calling Holy, Holy, Holy.

title.en: King Hezekiah prays and the angel strikes Sennacherib’s army
title.am: ንጉሥ ሕዝቅያስ ጸለየ፤ የእግዚአብሔር መልአክም አዳነው

events.note: Hezekiah laid Sennacherib’s threatening letter before the Lord, and that night the angel struck down the Assyrian camp.

title.en: Jeremiah warns Jerusalem before the Babylonian destruction
title.am: ኤርምያስ ስለ ኢየሩሳሌም ጥፋት አስጠነቀቀ

events.note: Jeremiah prophesied that the land would become desolate and Judah would serve the king of Babylon seventy years.

title.en: Daniel is delivered unharmed from the lions’ den
title.am: ዳንኤል ከአንበሶች ጉድጓድ ዳነ

events.note: King Darius found Daniel alive because God sent His angel to shut the lions’ mouths.

title.en: King Hezekiah: Reform, Siege, and Recovery
title.am: ንጉሥ ሕዝቅያስ፡ ተሃድሶ፣ ከበባና ፈውስ

title.en: Hezekiah opens and repairs the doors of the house of the Lord in his first month
title.am: ሕዝቅያስ በነገሠ በመጀመሪያው ወር የመቅደሱን በሮች ከፈተ

events.note: Consecrating priests and Levites to cleanse the sanctuary from contamination.

title.en: A great nationwide Passover is celebrated with joy not seen since Solomon
title.am: ከሰሎሞን ዘመን ወዲህ ያልታየ ታላቅ ፋሲካ ተከበረ

events.note: Extending the sacred festival an extra seven joyful days in Jerusalem.

title.en: Hezekiah breaks the bronze serpent Moses made because people burned incense to it
title.am: ሕዝቅያስ ሕዝቡ ያጥኑለት የነበረውን የናስ እባብ ሰበረው

events.note: Calling it Nehushtan (a mere piece of brass) to purge idolatrous superstition.

title.en: Hezekiah spreads Sennacherib’s blasphemous threatening letter before the Lord
title.am: ሕዝቅያስ የስናክሬምን የዛቻ ደብዳቤ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ዘረጋው

events.note: Praying: O Lord God of Israel, save us that all kingdoms may know You alone are God.

title.en: The angel of the Lord strikes 185,000 Assyrian troops in their camp overnight
title.am: የእግዚአብሔር መልአክ 185 ሺህ የአሦር ወታደሮችን መታ

events.note: Sennacherib withdrew in shame to Nineveh, where his own sons struck him.

title.en: Hezekiah weeps bitterly; God adds fifteen years to his life and turns the shadow back
title.am: ሕዝቅያስ አለቀሰ፤ እግዚአብሔርም 15 ዓመታት ጨመረለት

events.note: The sun’s shadow reversed ten degrees on the sundial of Ahaz as a divine sign.

title.en: The Glorious Resurrection and Forty Days to Ascension
title.am: ቅድስት ትንሣኤና አርባው ቀናት እስከ ዕርገት

title.en: Myrrh-bearing women find the stone rolled away and hear the angel: He is risen!
title.am: ቅዱሳት አንስት ድንጋዩ ተንከባሎ አገኙ፤ መልአኩም፡ ተነሥቷል አላቸው

events.note: He is not here; for He is risen, as He said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay.

title.en: The Risen Christ appears first to Mary Magdalene in the garden
title.am: ትንሣኤውን የገለጠው ጌታ በመጀመሪያ ለማርያም መግደላዊት ታየ

events.note: Jesus said to her: Mary! She turned and said: Rabboni! (Teacher).

title.en: Christ walks with Cleopas on the Emmaus road and is recognized in breaking bread
title.am: ክርስቶስ ወደ ኤማሁስ ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ጋር ተጓዘ፤ እንጀራውን ሲቆርስም ታወቀ

events.note: Their eyes were opened and they recognized Him; and He vanished from their sight.

title.en: The Risen Christ appears through closed doors: Peace be unto you
title.am: ክርስቶስ በዝግ በሮች መካከል ተገለጠ፤ ሰላም ለእናንተ ይሁን አላቸው

events.note: Showing them His hands and His side, breathing upon them: Receive the Holy Spirit.

title.en: Thomas touches the sacred nail prints: My Lord and my God!
title.am: ቶማስ የችንካሩን ቁስል ዳስሶ፡ ጌታዬና አምላኬ ብሎ መሰከረ

events.note: Blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed.

title.en: Christ blesses the Apostles and ascends into heaven from the Mount of Olives
title.am: ክርስቶስ ሐዋርያትን ባርኮ ከደብረ ዘይት ወደ ሰማይ ዐረገ

events.note: A cloud received Him out of their sight while angels promised His return.

title.en: Return from Exile: Rebuilding Temple and Walls
title.am: ከምርኮ መመለስ፡ የመቅደሱና የቅጥሩ መታነጽ

title.en: King Cyrus of Persia issues the decree permitting the Jews to return to Jerusalem
title.am: የፋርስ ንጉሥ ቂሮስ አይሁድ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም እንዲመለሱ አወጀ

events.note: The Lord stirred the spirit of Cyrus to build Him a house in Jerusalem.

title.en: Zerubbabel and Jeshua rebuild the altar of burnt offerings amidst fear
title.am: ዘሩባቤልና ኢያሱ የመሥዋዕቱን መሠዊያ እንደገና አቆሙ

events.note: Offering morning and evening sacrifices according to the Law of Moses.

title.en: The foundation of the Second Temple is laid with mixed shouts of joy and weeping
title.am: የሁለተኛው መቅደስ መሠረት በደስታና በልቅሶ ተጣለ

events.note: Old men who had seen the first temple wept aloud while others shouted for joy.

title.en: Prophets Haggai and Zechariah inspire the builders to resume temple work
title.am: ነቢያቱ ሐጌና ዘካርያስ ሠሪዎቹን አበረታቱ

events.note: Not by might nor by power, but by My Spirit, says the Lord of hosts.

title.en: The Second Temple is completed and dedicated with joyful Passover sacrifices
title.am: ሁለተኛው ቤተ መቅደስ ተጠናቆ በታላቅ ደስታ ተመረቀ

events.note: Celebrating with gladness because God turned the heart of the king to assist them.

title.en: Nehemiah finishes repairing Jerusalem’s collapsed walls in fifty-two days
title.am: ነህምያ የፈረሰውን የኢየሩሳሌም ቅጥር በ52 ቀናት ፈጸመ

events.note: All surrounding enemies perceived that this work was accomplished by our God.

title.en: The Anointing and Reign of David
title.am: የንጉሥ ዳዊት ቅባትና መንግሥት

title.en: Samuel anoints the shepherd boy David in Bethlehem
title.am: ሳሙኤል እረኛውን ዳዊትን በቤተልሔም ቀባው

events.note: The Spirit of the Lord came upon David from that day forward.

title.en: David strikes Goliath in the forehead with a sling and stone
title.am: ዳዊት ጎልያድን በወንጭፍ ድንጋይ ግንባሩን መታው

events.note: The battle is the Lord’s; the giant fell upon his face to the ground.

title.en: Elders of Israel crown David king over all Israel in Hebron
title.am: የእስራኤል ሽማግሌዎች ዳዊትን በኬብሮን አነገሡት

events.note: David was thirty years old when he became king, and he reigned forty years.

title.en: David brings the Ark of the Covenant to Mount Zion with dancing
title.am: ዳዊት ታቦቱን በደስታና በዝማሬ ወደ ጽዮን አመጣ

events.note: David danced before the Lord with all his might wearing a linen ephod.

title.en: God promises David an eternal throne through the prophet Nathan
title.am: እግዚአብሔር በነቢዩ ናታን አማካኝነት የዘላለም ዙፋን ቃል ገባለት

events.note: Your house and your kingdom shall be established forever before you.

title.en: The Devotion of Ruth: From Moab to Bethlehem
title.am: የሩት ታማኝነት፡ ከሞአብ እስከ ቤተልሔም

title.en: Ruth clings to Naomi, declaring: Your people shall be my people
title.am: ሩት ከኑኃሚን ጋር ተጣበቀች፤ ሕዝብሽ ሕዝቤ ነው አለች

events.note: Where you go I will go, and where you lodge I will lodge; your God my God.

title.en: Ruth gleans leftover barley in the field of wealthy Boaz
title.am: ሩት በቦዔዝ የእርሻ ቦታ የገብስ እሸት ቃረመች

events.note: Boaz noticed her modesty and ordered reapers to let grain fall for her.

title.en: Ruth lies at Boaz’s feet at the threshing floor asking for redemption
title.am: ሩት በአውድማው በቦዔዝ እግር አጠገብ ተኛች

events.note: Spread your garment over your handmaid, for you are a close redeemer.

title.en: Boaz redeems the family estate before ten elders at the city gate
title.am: ቦዔዝ በከተማይቱ በር በሽማግሌዎች ፊት ርስቱን ዋጀ

events.note: Taking off the sandal according to ancient custom in Israel.

title.en: Ruth marries Boaz and gives birth to Obed, the grandfather of David
title.am: ሩት ቦዔዝን አገባች፤ የዳዊት አያት የሆነውን ኢዮቤድን ወለደች

events.note: The women praised God: Naomi has a son who shall be a restorer of life.

title.en: Deliverance and Sustenance in the Wilderness
title.am: በምድረ በዳ የተደረጉ የማዳን ተአምራት

title.en: Moses casts a tree into the bitter spring of Marah to make it sweet
title.am: ሙሴ እንጨት ወደ መራራው ውኃ ጥሎ አጣፈጠው

events.note: The Lord proved them there: I am the Lord who heals you.

title.en: Manna rains down daily from heaven to feed the camp
title.am: በየማለዳው መና ከሰማይ እየወረደ ሕዝቡን መገበ

events.note: Providing daily bread for forty years until entering Canaan.

title.en: Moses strikes the rock at Horeb and streams of water pour out
title.am: ሙሴ በኮሬብ ዓለቱን መታ፤ ውኃም ፈለቀ

events.note: Quenching the thirst of the people and their flocks at Massah.

title.en: Aaron and Hur hold up Moses’ arms on the hill to defeat Amalek
title.am: አሮንና ሆር የሙሴን እጆች ደግፈው አማሌቅ ተሸነፈ

events.note: Joshua overwhelmed the Amalekite army with the edge of the sword.

title.en: Moses mounts the bronze serpent on a pole so bitten victims live
title.am: ሙሴ የናሱን እባብ በዓላማ ላይ ሰቅሎ ሕዝቡ ዳኑ

events.note: Whoever looked upon the uplifted emblem was healed from deadly venom.

title.en: Moses and the Wilderness Sanctuary
title.am: ሙሴና የምድረ በዳው ማደሪያ

title.en: Israel crosses the divided Red Sea safely
title.am: እስራኤል የተከፈለውን ቀይ ባሕር በሰላም ተሻገሩ

events.note: The waters were a wall to them on their right hand and on their left.

title.en: God delivers the Ten Commandments on Mount Sinai
title.am: እግዚአብሔር አሥርቱ ትእዛዛትን በደብረ ሲና ሰጠ

events.note: Thunder, lightning, and a thick cloud covered the smoking mountain.

title.en: Moses smashes the tablets and intercedes after the golden calf
title.am: ሙሴ ጽላቱን ሰብሮ ስለ ሕዝቡ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ማለደ

events.note: Moses pleaded for the people and God renewed the covenant.

title.en: Bezalel constructs the Tabernacle according to the divine pattern
title.am: ባስልኤል ማደሪያውን በታየው አምሳል ሠራ

events.note: Filled with the Spirit of God in wisdom, understanding, and craftsmanship.

title.en: The cloud covers the tent and God’s glory fills the Tabernacle
title.am: ደመናው ድንኳኑን ሸፈነው፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር ሞላው

events.note: The presence of the Lord guided Israel throughout all their journeys.
